story.jaymoskingdoms.farm_wake.awake: Oh! You're awake. Easy now, don't sit up too fast.
story.jaymoskingdoms.farm_wake.found: We found you out past the fields, cold as a stone. We couldn't just leave you lying there.
story.jaymoskingdoms.farm_wake.carried: So we carried you in and put you to bed. You've slept the best part of two days.
story.jaymoskingdoms.farm_wake.chest: Your things are in the chest by the bed. Every last bit, we didn't touch a thing.
story.jaymoskingdoms.farm_wake.welcome: You're welcome under our roof as long as you need. There's always work on a farm, if you've a mind for it.
story.jaymoskingdoms.farm_wake.child: Are you staying? Say you're staying!
story.jaymoskingdoms.farm_wake.rest: Rest a while first. Then come and find us in the fields.
story.jaymoskingdoms.farm_wake.alone: You wake in a stranger's bed. Your things are in the chest beside it.
